MuPDF release: 1.28.5
Git tag: 1.28.5
Git commit: 8ad45e92f0935d3d87f1db3f873086472a5e1b24
Source: https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/mupdf

The bootstrap script verifies this exact commit before building. It compiles
the PDF handler and Story/HTML layout engine while disabling JavaScript, OCR
output, barcode support, and non-PDF document handlers through compiler flags.

MuPDF is AGPL-3.0-or-later or commercially licensed. The prototype is intended
for personal AGPL-compatible use. Obtain a commercial Artifex license or replace
the backend before closed-source distribution.
